scope: SDK#2: eframe viewport clipboard factory, per-instance failure latching and explicit immediate viewport embedded fallback. Synthetic CPU tests and renderer builds only.

source.verification_method: Eight current files and retained snapshots match the recorded sizes/SHA256; git diff --exit-code against the local commit for those eight files returned 0; commit parent was checked.

implemented: NativeOptions.clipboard_factory is optional; Clone shares its Rc callback. The callback receives the actual viewport id, Arc<Window> and egui Context before its input State is created.
WGPU and Glow root, deferred and immediate viewport creation use the shared selection helper; a custom None payload or factory error never constructs the default clipboard.
Root clipboard errors propagate with viewport id and retained cause in the same frame, including after UI callbacks and viewport output processing.

Deferred clipboard initialization errors latch per instance before window creation on later frames; explicit recreation resets the latch. A failed factory does not publish an unroutable partial window.

An immediate renderer can signal on_failure before running user UI; Context embeds it once using the existing parent input and clipboard, retains the child declaration/latch and preserves the returned value. An already-produced native result wins without rerunning user UI.
Glow custom-state suspension clears the window-bound State and latch before releasing its window; the no-factory path retains baseline suspension and publication order.
OS/GL errors after a valid State are not clipboard failures and do not cause the factory to rerun for that State/window pair.
